name: Software Architecture Summit München 2027
description: German workshop summit on software architecture, with AI architecture bootcamps
note: Workshops + bootcamps, German; early bird savings up to 300 EUR until 17 Dec (likely 2026); prices excl. VAT
details: Monday to Wednesday are workshop days (half- and full-day), Thursday-Friday two bootcamps: 'KI-Architektur meistern' and 'GenAI & MLOps meistern'. 1-day ticket from 699 EUR (regular 749 EUR), 3-day workshop ticket from 1,399 EUR, 4-day ticket from 1,899 EUR, excl. VAT. Organized by entwickler.de / S&S Media; over 3,000 participants across 16 years of the summit. Session language not stated explicitly; the site is German.
